resources.string: Update checks prefer an official public manifest, so releases remain discoverable when the GitHub API is temporarily rate-limited. The manifest includes the signing-certificate fingerprint; the official APK URL, size, SHA-256, package, version code and original signature are verified. Checks detect same-name revisions by version code. A recent valid result can be used during a short network outage; repeated checks are throttled, while a manual check retries immediately. An older remote manifest cannot offer a downgrade. Storage is checked before downloading; matching partial files can resume after an interruption or cancellation. The verified APK is saved to public Download/DaidaiToolbox; a valid existing file is reused for manual confirmation in the system file manager.
